plan.title: Categorise meeting notes into decisions, actions, proposals, and questions

plan.title: Review minutes against requirements
plan.description: Check that the draft: (a) separates confirmed decisions, action items, proposals, and unresolved questions; (b) contains no invented decisions, owners, or deadlines; (c) reflects only the provided notes; (d) uses the required sections. Note any violations for correction.

plan.title: Generate Word document

open_questions: Who will own training materials? (explicitly unresolved)
Is the 2 November pilot confirmed? (discussed but not confirmed)
Is the next meeting on 23 October confirmed? (tentative only)
What is the deadline for Leon's SSO integration check? (no deadline agreed)

identified_gaps: Maya's statement 'product will simplify the first screen by 21 Oct' is presented as an agreed action item with a committed deadline and owner, but the notes only record it as a product intention, not a team-agreed action item.

The bug report requirement is labelled a 'Confirmed Decision' with 'The team agreed', yet the notes merely state 'Bug reports should have severity and reproduction steps' without explicit confirmation of team agreement.
The Proposals section rephrases 'Operations wants pilot with one department' as 'proposed by operations', shifting a stated preference into a proposal without clarification.
The Discussion Summary adds 'The team agreed that bug reports should include...' which infers agreement not explicitly recorded in the notes.
failed_checks: No invented decisions, owners, or deadlines
Distinguish confirmed vs proposed vs unresolved items
Reflect only what is stated in the notes
recommended_corrections: In Action Items, change Maya's row: remove 'Agreed' status, set Due Date to '21 October 2026 (product intention, not team commitment)', and add a note that this reflects Maya's statement, not a confirmed action item.

In Confirmed Decisions, either remove the 'team agreed' phrasing and label the bullet as 'Bug reports must include severity and reproduction steps (stated as requirement; confirmation needed)' or move it to Proposals/Unresolved if agreement is not explicit.
In Proposals, change the pilot bullet to 'Operations prefers a pilot with one department before broad rollout (stated preference; not yet a formal proposal)' to match the notes.
In Discussion Summary, replace 'The team agreed that bug reports should include...' with 'The team noted that bug reports should include severity and reproduction steps.'
remaining_issues: Whether the bug report requirement was formally agreed or merely discussed cannot be determined from the notes; a human must confirm.
The target department for the pilot and broad rollout timeline remain open and should be tracked.
The note taker is unspecified; this is a minor omission but not critical.
requirements_covered: Professional meeting minutes format with all required sections present
Clear separation of confirmed decisions, action items, proposals, and unresolved questions
No invented attendees, dates, or additional decisions beyond the notes
